subject: 9mmhandgun
leg: control: Valve's own against the brief
label: 9mmhandgun, in the place of the game's models/v_9mmhandgun.mdl, models/p_9mmhandgun.mdl, models/w_9mmhandgun.mdl

measured.lineup: the asset is one of A to D in lineup.png beside models/w_grenade.mdl, models/w_satchel.mdl, models/w_357.mdl
measured.lineupTest: asked 4 times, each in another order, which of the four was not made by Valve: judges picked A, A, D, D where the asset was B, D, A, B: passed for one of the game's

M1.reason: Reads as a pistol in every view: a long slide and barrel (about 9.5 long), a grip that drops off the slide at the rear, and a trigger-guard loop under the frame (below and top views). Nothing sticks out or is missing. The grip is a flat, blocky wedge, not a sculpted grip, but the outline is a pistol's.

M2.reason: Measured length 9.5 against the brief's 10, a difference of 2.8%, well within 15%. Width 1.9 and height 9.7 are not asked for.

M3.reason: Parts a 9mm semi-automatic pistol needs, listed down to the small ones: slide with serrations at the rear (first-person and in-hand views), barrel and muzzle opening (back and back-right views), trigger guard (top and below views), grip, magazine base, trigger, front sight, rear sight. The slide, barrel, trigger guard and grip are there. The trigger does not read in any view, and no front or rear sight shows clearly. The magazine base is not visible on the grip. A small part a pistol needs is missing or unreadable, so M3 is at most 1.

M4.reason: The brief asks for black and grey polymer and steel. The grip and frame read black (in-hand and first-person views) and the slide reads metallic grey. Each region is within what one would call the brief's colours.

M5.reason: The brief asks for no markings, so the bare surface counts. The slide and frame carry a vertical streaked pattern that reads as a smear across the slide (sides and first-person), and the grip is noisy grain, not the clean polymer and steel the brief describes. That is texture fault, not shape.

M6.reason: Capped at 2 for this brief, as the rubric says. In the line-up test it was not picked as the one not made by Valve: 0 of 4 readings (picks A, A, D, D against the asset at B, D, A, B), so it passed beside the three Valve originals.

M7.reason: The brief says it lies on its side on the floor. The w_ model is laid on its side: the thin 1.9 thickness is the vertical axis in the front view, and the grip extends sideways as the top view shows. It stands on its origin as a lying pistol would.

M8.reason: SMAK checkErrors list is empty. 88 triangles, well under twice the median (284) and under the third quartile (187). The only opening is the barrel's muzzle, which a player sees and which a pistol has (back and back-right views). Nothing floats or is inside out.

W1.reason: In first-person.png the asset sits where the game's own does: the grip in the orange hand at the bottom centre, the muzzle angled up and left, the same way round. Across the attack strip (SHOOT 0/14 to 14/14) the gun stays at the same relative place in the hand in every frame, and it does not part from the hand where both are seen.
